release.required_action: Publish a new non-v0.1.0 release from this exact source or fresh revalidated source; never reuse the v0.1.0 tag.

safe_next_steps.release_pending: Publish a new immutable release from the exact admitted source, then record and review its tag and archive identity in a new admission change.
safe_next_steps.compatible_supported: Retain the exact scoped claim only until the evidence expiry date and rerun the admission after any target or release change.
safe_next_steps.stale_evidence: Withdraw the claim and rerun the complete synthetic lifecycle checkpoint on the exact supported target.
safe_next_steps.changed: Withdraw the claim and evaluate the changed target or release as a new independently pinned support scope.
safe_next_steps.missing_evidence: Keep production support withdrawn until every exact evidence identity is available.
safe_next_steps.unsupported: Use a separately admitted profile and target; do not generalize this exact support scope.
safe_next_steps.unavailable: Keep production support withdrawn because the admitted target is unavailable.
